title: Primary Care Provider Assignment Changes: Rolling Limit and Accepted Channels
content:
Desk guidance for member services on how many **Primary Care Provider Assignment** changes a member may make for their own preference, which reasons are never limited, and how a request must arrive.

## The rule the desk applies

- Changes made for **member preference** are limited per rolling 365 days by the change limit of the practice type the member is leaving.
- A member-preference change is accepted only when the member's count of member-preference changes in the window is **below** the change limit of the currently active assignment's practice type. The count is taken from the member's change history on the system record before the change is accepted.
- Changes for **provider left network, provider dismissal, moved residence, access problem, age out** and **family alignment** never count toward the limit and are allowed at any time.
- A request is accepted only through a channel listed for the practice type, and the member's own statement of the reason is recorded. A change for provider left network or provider dismissal must match a notice already on the member's record.

## How the count is taken

The window is the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the request date, both ends included. The count is the number of the member's recorded change requests with the reason member preference and a request date inside the window, not counting any change whose resulting assignment was withdrawn before it took effect.

## Schedule

| Practice type | Member-preference changes per rolling 365 days | Accepted channels |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Primary Care Provider | 3 | Phone, member portal, mobile app |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider | 3 | Phone, member portal, mobile app |
| OB/GYN Primary Care Provider | 3 | Phone, member portal, mobile app |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 3 | Phone, member portal, mobile app |
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 2 | Phone, member portal, mobile app |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 2 | Phone, member portal, mobile app |
| Health Home Lead Provider | 2 | Phone, member portal, mobile app |

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates and histories)

- **Window edges.** For a request dated 10 May 2026 the window runs from 11 May 2025 through 10 May 2026. A member-preference change dated 11 May 2025 is inside it; one dated 10 May 2025 is outside it.
- **Below the limit.** A member whose active assignment is a Standard Primary Care Provider has two member-preference changes in the window. Two is below 3, so a further member-preference change is accepted.
- **At the limit.** A member whose active assignment is a Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice has two member-preference changes in the window. Two is not below 2, so a member-preference change is not accepted.
- **Withdrawn change.** One of those two changes produced an assignment that was withdrawn before it took effect. It is not counted, the count is one, and a member-preference change is accepted.
- **Exempt reason.** A member at the limit reports that the practice failed an access standard. A change for access problem does not count toward the limit and is allowed.
- **Notice on record.** A member asks to change for provider dismissal. The reason is accepted only where a dismissal notice is already on the member's record.
